knowledge_before_run: H7 has two collision pairs at n=7; D resolves the complete n<=7 corpus.
M11 separates the known n8 degree pair, but not the two n7 seeds.
Neighbor profiles contain D and therefore inherit its known finite n<=7 resolution.
Literature reports effective quill perturbations through n=9, with operators and protocol different from this exact paired S/A/K deck.
All six control pairs are known, not held out. New sample matrices and this comparison have not been computed before contract publication.

challenge.edge_rule: For each i<j, SHA256 UTF-8 seed|n|threshold|draw|i|j; first digest byte modulo 8 < threshold. Then take strict transitive closure.
challenge.deduplication: Exact directed isomorphism only; retain first draw representative and full draw-to-representative mapping.
challenge.distribution: Biased upper-DAG closure sample, not uniform over labelled or unlabelled posets, not an exhaustive n=8 or n=9 corpus.

conventions.C: Full strict transitive causal relation; direction-preserving isomorphism, no quotient by duality
conventions.D: Sorted multiset of (strict predecessor count,strict successor count).
conventions.M11: Sum of common successor counts over unordered pairs of minimal elements each with exactly one strict successor.
conventions.N1: Sorted multiset over roots v of [degree(v),sorted degrees of all strict predecessors,sorted degrees of all strict successors]. One fixed round; full relations, not Hasse edges.
conventions.Q1: For each root v, add one new point z either with edge v<z or z<v, then take full transitive closure. Store ordered pair [chi_S/A/K of future extension,chi_S/A/K of past extension]. Sort these root-pairs as a multiset, preserving multiplicity and within-root direction pairing.
conventions.extra_information: No new adaptive motif, extra iteration, invariant or operator after outcomes.

endpoints: Per-size and per-panel class count, unresolved nonisomorphic pair count, maximum class size and every residual group for every method.
Each of six known control pairs: separated or unresolved for every method.
Record exact incremental characteristic-polynomial calls and integer payload counts; wall times are single-environment observations, not industrial efficiency claims.

Finite admissibility requires no unresolved census pair, all six controls separated and no unresolved pair in the fixed deduplicated challenge. Report failures; this gate does not certify future inputs.

Among finitely admissible extensions, order by additional polynomial calls, then total integer payload count. Recommend at most a bounded prefilter with exact-isomorphism fallback; never replace full relation or infer identity from equality.
verification: Producer: Faddeev-LeVerrier integer recurrence with Cayley-Hamilton residual; direct closed-form quill rows/columns.
Checker: no producer import; Bareiss determinant interpolation; graph edge insertion followed by closure; explicit motif counts and separately assembled neighborhood multisets.
Replay challenge hashes; exact isomorphism checks for every deduplication, no spectral deduplication.
Compare all full values, partitions and all control results; relabel every input by reversal and verify invariance by transporting all quill matrices under the relabelling.
Reject missing transitive closure, lost multiplicity, reversed direction pairing, altered polynomial, forged deduplication and omitted collision groups.

decisions.PASS_FINITE_COMPARISON: All fixed records completed and exact countercheck/negative controls passed; individual methods may still fail resolution.
decisions.INCONCLUSIVE: Timeout, missing input, code disagreement, incomplete countercheck or failed negative control. Retain partial artifacts without declaring completion.

freeze_policy: Contract published before new comparison. Source and runner hashes must also be published before the first target run; history retained. Fixes require a recorded deviation and a fresh run.
